scope: Independent offline audit of all observed v1 request timings and intact sequence reuse; no inference, no raw edits

original_failure.message: robot response omits requested temporal memory detail

last_sequence.quality_treatment: Fourth turn remains an undelivered technical failure in every denominator.
last_sequence.normalization_boundary: Only sequence completion eligibility may be normalized; never alter raw status/error/response/timestamps/calls or convert failed delivery to success.

reuse_decision: All88 measured turns and22 intact four-turn sequences eligible for a version-stratified continuation; no answered/failed turn or entire sequence should be rerun.
permitted_source_change: Runner scheduling classification of response-validation failure as nonfatal; matching offline regression tests. No generator/routing/retrieval/validation/settings change.
